profiles.method: scripts/assemble_cohort3_profiles.py (adapted from assemble_sec_provider_profiles.py): SEC EDGAR submissions (archived, SHA-256 checked) for headquarters and SIC industry; Data Legion companies/enrich-base via Firecrawl Alexandria by ticker_symbol for website, LinkedIn, founded year and provider size band, accepted only for an exact/high-confidence ticker match of a public record whose name agrees with the issuer, plus a per-ticker manual review of every mismatch. Published with scripts/publish_company_profiles.publish (validate, merge, backups, lease, exact readback); its bundled-fallback directory write was redirected to the working directory so the checkout stayed unchanged.

provider.credit_basis: 20 credits per successful enrichment; not-found lookups were not charged (sum of creditsCost over 41 responses)
